You paused a client's ads. They kept spending.

Adspenta is a marketing tool for agencies that run clients' Meta and Google ads. About a minute after it sends a change, like a pause, it checks with Meta that the change really happened. If it didn't, you see it within minutes.

Has a paused ad ever kept spending on one of your clients?

We'll look over one client's Meta ad account for free. You get a one page report, and we change nothing. Request it at adspenta.com, link in bio.

Why don't agency owners trust automation on live client accounts?

Adspenta is a marketing tool for agencies that run clients' Meta and Google ads. A person approves every change, it waits five minutes so you can take it back, and afterwards Adspenta checks with Meta that it really happened. One switch stops everything.

Would you let a tool touch your client accounts?

Free check of one client's Meta ad account. You get a one page report, and nothing gets changed. Ask at adspenta.com, link in bio.
